description: Creates a new household task. Only title is required; the task starts unassigned and uncompleted. Set reminders with reminderOffsetMinutes. Use assign_task, update_task, or complete_task to change it afterward.

isUrgent.description: Mark the task urgent so it is shown first and highlighted.

notes.description: Freeform notes. Not for assignment info.

preparationDate.description: Legacy single reminder date, YYYY-MM-DD; use reminderOffsetMinutes instead. Ignored when reminderOffsetMinutes is sent. Must be on or before dueDate, and needs dueDate.

reminderOffsetMinutes.description: Reminder lead times, in minutes before the due date. Each value is whole hours, 60-1380 (1-23 hours), or whole days, a multiple of 1440 up to 525600 (365 days); a week is 10080. Up to 5 values. A due date counts from 00:00 on that day, so 300 (5 hours) is 19:00 the evening before. Day and week reminders arrive at 19:00 on the earlier day; hour reminders arrive that many hours before, or up to 15 minutes earlier. Needs dueDate.

items.description: One lead time in minutes: whole hours 60-1380, or a multiple of 1440 for days.

title.description: Task title, e.g. 'Take out the recycling'.

name: create_task
